system_note: SNOMED CT because that is what LocalPatientStore reports on Condition.code: 419 of the 421 conditions in the committed bundles carry this system. A set of A56432's ICD-10 codes would match nobody (D52, REQ-59).
compiled_from: A56432's ICD-10-CM codes that support medical necessity, narrowed to the rheumatoid arthritis indication. The article's Group 1 carries 406 codes across every indication L35677 covers -- Crohn's disease, psoriasis, sarcoidosis and the rest -- and this tree is compiled for the rheumatoid arthritis bullet alone, so the set is that bullet's subset and says so.

mapping.basis: SNOMED CT 69896004 and ICD-10-CM M06.9 both denote rheumatoid arthritis. No corpus document and no credential-free re-downloadable source binds the two systems -- D36's finding, re-checked for T-92: the SNOMED browser API answers 405 and the NLM clinical tables carry no SNOMED identifier. The SNOMED code is the one Synthea's own rheumatoid_arthritis module emits (ConditionOnset, SNOMED-CT 69896004), read from modules/rheumatoid_arthritis.json inside the pinned synthea-with-dependencies.jar, so it is the code a chart in this corpus actually carries rather than one recalled.

known_limit: One entry. A chart coding rheumatoid arthritis more specifically -- seropositive, or by joint -- abstains rather than matching, which is a false abstention and not a false verdict. Widening it needs a SNOMED source this project can re-read, which is the same thing D36 was blocked on.
